title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Where to find all standard AL namespaces? (Download all AL namespaces)
summary: The post explains how to find and download all standard AL namespaces in Business Central by viewing the AllObjWithCaption virtual table and creating a list page with analysis mode to group and export the data.
key_points: Namespaces organize code into logical groups and prevent naming conflicts
The AllObjWithCaption virtual table (2000000058) displays AL Namespace information for all objects
Create a list page based on AllObjWithCaption to access analysis mode features
Use analysis mode to group namespaces and export data to Excel

quotes.text: Namespaces are used to organize code into logical groups and hierarchies, which can prevent naming conflicts that can occur when libraries are combined.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the purpose of namespaces in preventing code conflicts and organizing code structure
